'''Blithane''' was the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Governor/Legends|governor]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lo'Uran]]. Blithane was corrupt, and eventually arrested by the [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]] for stealing equipment and selling them on to criminal syndicates.
